hook.en: A lion and a tiger look different, yet they share more with each other than with a house cat. *Taxonomic categories* capture exactly how close two organisms are.
hook.kn: ಸಿಂಹ ಮತ್ತು ಹುಲಿ ಬೇರೆಯಾಗಿ ಕಂಡರೂ ಮನೆಯ ಬೆಕ್ಕಿಗಿಂತ ಪರಸ್ಪರ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಹೋಲುತ್ತವೆ. ವರ್ಗೀಕರಣ ಶ್ರೇಣಿಗಳು ಈ ಹತ್ತಿರದ ಸಂಬಂಧವನ್ನು ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

body.en: A *species* is a group of individual organisms with fundamental similarities. Mangifera indica (mango), Solanum tuberosum (potato) and Panthera leo (lion) are species. Species is the lowest taxonomic category.
body.kn: ಮೂಲಭೂತ ಹೋಲಿಕೆಗಳಿರುವ ಜೀವಿಗಳ ಗುಂಪೇ ಪ್ರಭೇದ. ಉದಾ: Mangifera indica, Solanum tuberosum, Panthera leo. ಪ್ರಭೇದ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಕೆಳಗಿನ ಶ್ರೇಣಿ.

narration.en: Lion, tiger and leopard are three species of the genus Panthera; the cat is in another genus, Felis. Both genera are in the family Felidae, while dogs and wolves (genus Canis) are in Canidae. Both families belong to the order Carnivora. Going up the levels, more organisms are included and they share fewer characters.
narration.kn: ಸಿಂಹ, ಹುಲಿ ಮತ್ತು ಚಿರತೆ ಪ್ಯಾಂಥೆರಾ ಕುಲದ ಮೂರು ಪ್ರಭೇದಗಳು; ಬೆಕ್ಕು ಫೆಲಿಸ್ ಕುಲದಲ್ಲಿದೆ. ಎರಡೂ ಕುಲಗಳು ಫೆಲಿಡೇ ಕುಟುಂಬದಲ್ಲಿ, ನಾಯಿ ಮತ್ತು ತೋಳ (ಕ್ಯಾನಿಸ್) ಕ್ಯಾನಿಡೇಯಲ್ಲಿ. ಎರಡೂ ಕುಟುಂಬಗಳು ಕಾರ್ನಿವೋರಾ ಗಣಕ್ಕೆ ಸೇರಿವೆ. ಮೇಲಿನ ಹಂತಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಜೀವಿಗಳು, ಕಡಿಮೆ ಸಮಾನ ಲಕ್ಷಣಗಳು.

title.en: On the board: Taxonomic categories: species, genus, family

say.en: Let us build the tree for the big cats and the domestic cat.
At the bottom are species: leo, tigris, pardus and catus. Species is the lowest category.
Related species form a genus: Panthera for the big cats, Felis for the cat.
Related genera form a family: Panthera and Felis are both in Felidae.
Lower taxa share more characters than higher ones.

explanation.en: A family groups related genera. Solanum, Petunia and Datura share flower and fruit characters (Solanaceae). Panthera and Felis are in Felidae; dogs and wolves (genus Canis) are in Canidae.

body.en: A *genus* is a group of related species. Potato, tomato and brinjal are species of Solanum; lion, leopard and tiger are species of Panthera. A family is a group of related genera: Panthera and Felis (cat) are in Felidae, and Solanum, Petunia and Datura are in Solanaceae.

points.en: Felidae = Panthera + Felis; Solanaceae = Solanum + Petunia + Datura

tagline.en: The hierarchy from species to kingdom, worked placements of human, housefly, mango and wheat, and taxonomic aids such as herbaria and keys.

say.en: Hierarchy: species, genus, family, order, class, phylum/division, kingdom.
Higher categories include more organisms with fewer shared characters.
Taxonomic aids: herbaria, botanical gardens, museums, zoos and keys.
A key uses couplets of contrasting characters (leads).

goal.en: The hierarchy from species to kingdom, worked placements of human, housefly, mango and wheat, and taxonomic aids such as herbaria and keys.

takeaway.en: Hierarchy: species, genus, family, order, class, phylum/division, kingdom.

headline.en: A couplet gives two opposite choices, e.g. 1a. Leaves needle-like … go to 2; 1b.

problem.en: Panthera leo, Panthera tigris and Felis catus are given. Which two belong to the same genus, and what single family holds all three?

steps.en: The first word of the name is the genus: Panthera, Panthera, Felis.
So the lion and the tiger share the genus Panthera; the cat is in Felis.
Panthera and Felis are related genera grouped in the family Felidae.

answer.en: Lion and tiger (Panthera); all three are in Felidae
